comment: 25 natural-language queries over fixtures/semantic. No query word is (or shares a stem prefix with) a token of the target's identifier; verify/semantic.mjs re-checks this before measuring.

queries.text: make a URL-friendly version of a heading
tally the tokens separated by spaces in a sentence
shorten long text and add three dots at the end
does a phrase read identically in reverse
minimum number of single character edits between two strings
split a spreadsheet record into its fields respecting quotes
repeat an operation after errors, waiting longer each attempt
securely store a user's secret with a salt
check an @ address has a user part and a dotted domain
distance between two GPS coordinates on the globe
limit how many requests per second are allowed, with bursts
memory store that forgets the least recently used entries
wait until the user stops typing before running a callback
show a file size as KB, MB or GB
how long since an event happened, e.g. 3 minutes earlier
put text onto the system pasteboard
split a list into groups of a fixed size
randomly permute the elements of an array
text field that displays how many letters are left before the maximum
click to give a score from one to five
divide and conquer ordering of numbers
find a value in an ordered slice by halving the range
largest number dividing both integers evenly
sequence the jobs so that prerequisites come first
archive a folder into a dated tarball and delete old archives
